name: Demon Mask
desc: A haunting feeling creeps upon you, as you behold the mask in your hand, resembling a masterful depiction of a monstrous being. You know it is of traditional Etrean make, and features some motif of folklore - but beyond that, you know little else. Clearly, this is a relic from a time long past. A mask of warriors long-forgotten: their names forever lost to history, their lives - to calamity.
